name: Native Probe Adequacy under Strict Extension

objects.C_j: packaged audit on stage coordinate carrier E_j
objects.A_j: adequacy amplification map from native responses to dissolving responses
objects.K_L_j: native currency matrix L_j C_j^dagger L_j^*
objects.K_D_j: dissolving currency matrix D_j C_j^dagger D_j^*
objects.K_R_j: residual currency matrix R_j C_j^dagger R_j^*

gates: adequacy factorization D_j = A_j L_j + R_j
amplification budget A_j Theta_L_j A_j^* <= Theta_A_j

statuses.accepted: native membrane promotes to layer-dissolving membrane
statuses.defect_paid: residual budget included in dissolving membrane
statuses.strict_extension_accepted: residual promoted into native family and retested
statuses.native_only: native probes priced but layer-dissolving adequacy absent
statuses.failed_adequacy: blind spot not factored, promoted, or excluded
statuses.overread: native membrane asserted as full dissolving membrane without adequacy
